content: Mada Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọkkaan ọrọbha Devid ka mbọhk s'attattaanga-nọng pẹ biphyir, ọmaana ka mbọhk sa Saul, wa ọkkọhn ẹmọng ọnang Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi.

content.text: “Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi wọ ode ẹtzakpa chaam,
obiro ode ichubhabe saam,
ọmaana ọkkaan kwaam;
Ibinọkpaabyi kwaam wọ ode ẹtzakpa chaam, cha kaam nchubh,
ode ọkhọhnkpa ọmaana ẹfa ch'ẹnaanga chaam.
Kẹ wọ ode etzumi-nnam chaam, ichubhabe saam ọmaana ọkkaan kwaam,
kẹ wọ ọkkaan-m ka mbọhk s'agbagbaana.
“Kaam nyeri Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, kw'ọbaan k'ẹtzọhnga,
kw'ọkk'aam ọkkaana ka mbọhk s'attattaanga-nọng paam.
“Ebukhaya ch'obo ẹkk'aam ẹbhọri,
nttẹri s'ekhibhi ẹkk'aam ẹfa ẹna.
Ndik s'epekhubh nkk'nyokha ngọr-m,
agbagbara p'obo akk'aam abẹ ayina.
“Kaam nyeri Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi k'iyayakhi-dik saam,
Kaam nyeri Ibinọkpaabyi kwaam bi ọkkaan-m.
Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọbhaanga ẹmọng chaam k'ọhọhm kwẹ;
ẹmọng cha mmomi ẹkk'ẹ ẹtta k'itzọhng.
“Ọyagbin ọfhọni obiro ọkhaama opoma,
agbaari p'ọrọngkpakpa anyengi,
bẹ afhọni okhuri idọdọkhi sẹ.
Irorong iyin-ẹ k'ahung-mma,
ekpon ch'echi ibe eyin-ẹ k'ẹmma,
akpongkkang abira awọma ekpon mẹ.
Kẹ ọbhaangi ọrọngkpakpa orenga mẹ ọhakha,
eboni ch'epyi bi kaang ewobh ka mmokpatzọkhi sẹ.
Kẹ ovur ka chẹrubim okhur,
orenga ka mbabaang s'ọphapha okhur.
Otzim orungibanga osi ikhira s'ikhọr-ẹ,
osi eboni ch'ẹrọng ch'epyi erungi bi kkaang k'ọrọngkpakpa.
K'ottem kw'ọyaanttaani, k'itzitzikha sẹ,
akpongkkang p'ekpon awọma.
Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi otto etzum mach'ẹbhaang-kpon k'ọvaarbhon kwẹ.
Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi kw'Ọyọhng obiro ọkpẹbh ẹmọng k'ẹrọng.
Kẹ ọtta ayuk, okwuri attattaanga-nọng,
otzima akpongkkang p'awọm ekpon ch'ideden okhubh bẹ.
Ẹmọng ch'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọkpẹbhi,
ọwọhng kw'oji k'ahung-mma pẹ,
osi nttẹri s'araanga p'ideden njana,
osi agbaari p'ọyagbin abira atte eje.
“Kẹ owobh k'ẹrọng, onemi ọbọhk ọbọkh-m,
ọrọbh-m k'asi p'adong-odong, otzima oyin ka.
Kẹ ọrọbh-m ka mbọhk s'ẹfa ch'attattaanga-nọng paam,
ka mbọhk s'attattaanga-nọng paam, p'agaangi ayọhng-m.
Bẹ arim-m abẹ, k'ewu ch'idik ikhebh-m,
kaambi mẹ wọ, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi wọ iwa ode etzumi-nnam chaam.
Kẹ ohokh-m k'ibe s'iwoni-owoni,
ọkkaan-m, okhuri da ọdaami ettem ttar-m.
“Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọkk'aam ochora otzor k'etzora chaam,
ọkk'aam ochora otzor k'awurada pa mbọhk saam.
Da kaam nkk'ndora ka nden s'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi,
aponga kaam kapyibhi, da nni nnam mkpa mbọra Ibinọkpaabyi kwaam.
Kaam nkk'aphaangi pẹ biphyir nhokha,
kaam nnam kimbiri mkpa mbọra ndọhna sẹ.
Kaam oponga-pyibha k'itzitzikha sẹ kingaam,
nkk'for saam ndọra k'ẹkhọngkwuri.
Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọkk'aam ochora k'etzora chaam,
ọkk'aam ochora otzor k'awurada paam p'ore.
“Ọnọng nwuma kw'ọhak eho ọnang-ọ,
kẹ wọ kwa kọ ahọk idadaakha sọ.
Kọ asi ejibha atzima atzor, ọnọng kw'oni oponga-pyibha ọkhaam.
Ọnọng kw'owur-owur, kẹ kw'akhọhk awurada pọ,
yina, ọnọng kw'osi ebibya, kọ asẹ-ẹ ọgbaan.
Kọ akkaan ọnọng kw'okhom for sẹ,
yina, ahak ọnọng kw'are bi, oge for ewobha.
Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, kọ wọ ade ottwikkaang kwaam,
Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi osi ipyerungi saam, in-ide iyaan.
Kọ akkaan-m bi, nnọbh mmaam k'ottem kw'agbong-nọng p'attaang-m,
k'ẹfa ch'Ibinọkpaabyi kwaam, kaam mfha ngwur abaakha pabẹ njekha.
“Eden ch'Ibinọkpaabyi etzor-otzor:
Atzim p'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi epina kakhaam
Kẹ ode ọkhọhnkpa kw'ọbaabh anọng p'achubh ka kẹ.
Anyi wọ kw'ám-okpobha oyongi Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi o?
Anyi wọ ode Ẹtzakpa chaman, oyongi Ibinọkpaabyi o?
Kẹ Ibinọkpaabyi wọ otzim ẹfa chẹ ọbaabh-m,
obiro osi ọbaabha eden chaam.
Kẹ osi mmo saam ngaama ẹfa macha s'ochimi,
osi-m mbe k'obe f'ogor-ogori.
Kẹ okpebhi mbọhk saam erima,
mbọhk saam mfha mmena oyuk kwa brons.
Ẹkkaana chọ ch'anang-m ede ọkhọhnkpa kwaam,
ẹkkaana chọ ẹkk'aam ẹsa mbar.
Kọ asi-m nnenga k'ọkkadeden kw'owoni-owoni,
mmo-dọhngi kaam kindebh.
“Kaam ngwubhi attattaanga-nọng paam, mbiri ndimi bẹ,
nnam kimkpa maa, ndimi bẹ.
Ndimi bẹ biphyir-phyir, bẹ dọk kafha abina,
bẹ an-atto ayim-m ka mmokpatzọkhi.
Kọ anang-m ẹfa ch'egbong oririma,
asi attattaanga-nọng paam, ahakha nho anang-m.
Kọ asi attattaanga-nọng paam arọbh-m,
kaam mbiri ndimi anọng p'attaang-m.
Bẹ abhom aror ẹkkaana, ọnọng kw'ọkkaan bẹ kode.
Bẹ abhom ayeri Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, bẹ ebhina kobiro ọnang.
Kaam ngokhi bẹ ayọhri mach'ọkpọhm kw'irerek,
nduk bẹ, mbiri mbari bẹ mmo mach'ẹdọdọhbhi cha mkpaanga-den.
“Kọ akk'aam akkaana ka mbọhk s'idibhon s'irim-m abẹ,
ahokh-m mach'oho kw'idibhon.
Anọng p'iwa nninong an-awobha k'irekh-irek kwaam.
Akhekhennọng awobh k'ojora k'itzitzikha saam;
ogbe kwa bẹ abhaang odik okhuri kaam bi kpaar, bẹ ahakha eho anang-m.
Ẹfa ẹha akhekhennọng mba biphyir,
bẹ afona k'ochubhabe fabẹ, akwu k'opoma.
“Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi orukhi akpen! Ẹtzọhnga ewobha ẹnang Ẹtzakpa chaam!
Tte abarada awobha anang Ibinọkpaabyi, kw'ode Ẹtzakpa chaam, obiro ode Ọkkaan kwaam!
Kẹ wọ ode Ibinọkpaabyi kw'om-otzukha idik k'eho chaam,
kẹ ohokhi idibhon bi, iwobha k'irekh-irek kwaam,
kẹ wọ ọkkaan-m ka mbọhk s'attattaanga-nọng paam.
Kọ atzin-m k'ebe ch'ẹyọhng ch'attattaanga-nọng paam,
akkaan-m ka mbọhk s'ọgbagbaana.
Kẹ wọ osi, kaam ńdọhnga kọ Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi, k'ottem kw'idibhon;
kaam ńkkọhn amọng ndima ndọhnga che chọ.
“Kẹ ọnangi ọvaarnọng kwẹ ngema sa ndeden,
osi ejibha-barada ọnang nwuma kw'obyengi ana k'eho,
kw'ode Devid ọmaana va pa va pẹ maa, ogbe ode.”
